name: asemode
description: Native character-cell drawing, TrueType fonts, and portable textmode tilemaps for Aseprite.
author: textmode.art

scripts.test: npm run format:check && npm run check:jsdoc && npm run check:lua && npm run test:portable && npm run fonts:check && npm run test:fonts && npm run unicode:check && npm run test:font-identities && npm run build && npm run test:package && npm run test:tooling
scripts.build: npm run fonts:generate && node scripts/build/generate-unicode-names.mjs && node scripts/build/package.mjs
scripts.check:lua: npm run format:lua:check && npm run lint:lua && npm run test:lua
scripts.format: textmode-lint format scripts tests/node package.json release.config.cjs eslint.config.mjs .github
scripts.format:check: textmode-lint format:check scripts tests/node package.json release.config.cjs eslint.config.mjs .github
scripts.itch:dry-run: npm run build && node scripts/check/check-package.mjs --release && node scripts/build/itch.mjs dry-run
scripts.itch:preview: npm run build && node scripts/check/check-package.mjs --release && node scripts/build/itch.mjs preview
scripts.itch:publish:first: npm run build && node scripts/check/check-package.mjs --release && node scripts/build/itch.mjs publish:first
scripts.itch:publish: npm run build && node scripts/check/check-package.mjs --release && node scripts/build/itch.mjs publish
